title: krn adopt admits a testless repository in a bootstrap state whose only admitted task adds the first real test
body:
Why: Fable plan 1114d (.krn/runs/overnight/fable-plan-1114d.md): 11/15 operator repos fail adopt exit 64 because the contract is vacuous, and the seeded first-test task can never be delivered (deadlock: src/adopt/adopt.ts:350, src/adopt/canary.ts:234, src/cli/adopt.ts:181).
Outcome: on a vacuous contract adopt exits 0, keeps the adoption set, records state bootstrap in krn.json (or .krn), and the canary proves the Stop gate refuses vacuous instead of skipping.
Proof: test/adopt/bootstrap.test.ts on a real testless git fixture: adopt exit 0, files kept, state bootstrap; census adopt column improves.
